text: なんど　わたしの　いえを　ねんじても…　なぜか　ここに　とんで　きちゃうの！

structure.jp: なんど　わたしの　いえを　ねんじても…
structure.en: no matter how many times I picture my house...

structure.jp: なぜか　ここに　とんで　きちゃうの！
structure.en: somehow I end up flying here!

patterns.name: 〜ても
patterns.span: なんど　わたしの　いえを　ねんじても
patterns.explanation: A question word plus a て verb and も means 'no matter how'. なんど　ねんじても = 'however many times I picture it'.

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.explanation: ちゃう is the short spoken form of てしまう, saying something happens against your wishes. きちゃう = 'I end up coming'.

patterns.name: 〜てくる
patterns.explanation: くる after a て verb shows the action heading to where the speaker is. とんで　くる = 'come flying here'.
